## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:41` — `BRANCH` = current branch minus `feature/`; the spec dir is `.specify/specs/$BRANCH/`.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:50-55` — subcommands named here `cd` to the spec root first; a new artifact predicate must join this list or it breaks in a monorepo app folder.
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:239-246` — `check-plan`: `PLAN_FOUND: <b>` exit 0 / `NO_PLAN_FOR_BRANCH: <b>` exit 1. Its only caller is `commands/hef.tasks.md:22` (grep over `commands/`, `evals/`, `workflows/`, `agents/`, `skills/`).
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:227-229` — `plan` fetcher: on absence `missing_artifact` dies on stderr, exit 1 — why the light path must not call it.
- `tests/smoke.sh:2475-2483` — `dc_subs` counts simple `case` arms (`^  name)`); a new arm raises the count to 47, and README.md + docs/architecture.md must say "(47 subcommands)".
- `tests/smoke.sh:743-775` — every `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` invocation in `commands/` is executed in a scratch repo; an `Unknown command:` fails the suite, so the new pre-flight line is validated automatically.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Predicates answer with a string AND an exit code; absence of a precondition is exit 1 (constitution principle 5; `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:230-246`).
- Helper-contract smoke cases run in a `mktemp -d` scratch repo with `git init` + a `feature/<name>` branch (`tests/smoke.sh:470-478`), cite their reason in comments, and report via `ok`/`bad`.
- Generated artifacts carry HTML-comment header lines (`commands/hef.tasks.md:44-45`).
- Every guard is mutation-tested (constitution principle 3): reintroduce the bug, see red.
